text:
Ellen (People Ops): Heads-up: Maya (artist) coming at 3:30pm with a small sculpture + a potted plant. She's bringing her aunt who has noise sensitivity and a small service dog (Maru). Also, a FedEx package arrived earlier for Suite 7B (we're 7A). Kiosk sometimes times out. Can someone stand by for manual badge + a low-traffic seat by the east bay window?

Sam (Front Desk): Copy that. Kiosk throwing 502 for me. I can do manual badges. Where should the FedEx box go?

ParcelBot: Delivery log: FedEx delivered at 11:05am. Package labeled "Suite 7B". Status: left at front desk.

Jon: I moved the misdelivered box to Mailroom Rack 3 and tagged it "7B - misdelivered". Left a sticky for Logistics pickup.

Ellen (People Ops): Thanks Jon. Please reserve the east bay cushioned bench; add a throw and small side table for water. Visitor badge should be photo+visitor role for the day. If kiosk fails, use manual flow below.

Sam (Front Desk): Manual badge fallback (kiosk down):
```
# manual visitor badge
/usr/bin/capture --out /tmp/maya.jpg --cam frontdesk
/usr/local/bin/create_badge --name "Maya" --role Visitor --photo /tmp/maya.jpg --ttl 1d > /tmp/maya_badge.pdf
lp -d Badge_Printer /tmp/maya_badge.pdf
```
I'll also enable guest-wifi for 24h.

BadgePrinterBot: NOTICE - low ribbon at 3:28pm, attempting draft print.

Priya: I'll meet the courier at 3:25 to bring coats and set up the bench. I can bring a small lamp with a soft shade, avoid overheads for Maru.

ParcelBot: Courier updated: Maya en route, estimated 3:29pm.

Sam (Front Desk): Printed badge in draft mode at 3:29pm. Lanyards low, issuing clip-on.

Jon: Courier stopped by and signed. Sculpture and plant stored in Storage Bay C with label "Maya - fragile". Left a note: "spare hook taped to pot".

Maya (Visitor): Hi all! Thanks for holding my piece. My aunt would love the bench by the bay. Maru is crate-trained and quiet. I taped a spare hanging hook into the plant pot labeled "hang - north beam" for the install crew.

Ellen (People Ops): Bench, throw, side table + water are all set. Noted the hook in the pot and added to install notes. Quick poll: leave a small bottled water on the table? Reply :thumbsup: yes / :no_entry: no

Maya (Visitor): :thumbsup:

Sam (Front Desk): Water placed. Maya checked in at 3:31pm, ID verified, badge issued (clip-on). Aunt seated at bay bench, Maru settled on mat. Misdelivered FedEx moved to Mailroom Rack 3 for logistics pickup. All good.

Ellen (People Ops): Thanks team  added "spare hook in pot" to facilities notes and pinged Install channel. Closing thread  appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:
